meta.title: AgentBridge — Large File Preview & Export Semantics
meta.subtitle: Separation of Bounded Window Preview from Deterministic Multipart Export
meta.description: Architectural workflow distinguishing Total File Size, Requested Preview Window, Single Scan Budget, and Export Chunk Size across preview and multi-part export lifecycles.

states.label: File Selected in Workspace
states.description: Operator selects a file from the repository (e.g. 50 MB, 100 MB, or 120 MB local file).

states.label: Metadata & Classification
states.description: Inspects file size, detects binary/text, determines version token, and checks export eligibility (<= 200 MB).

states.label: Preview vs. Export Decision
states.description: Distinguishes content preview inspection from transport file export.

states.label: Requested Preview Window
states.description: Operator specifies target window (e.g. lines 17200-17234, default 35 lines, max 200 lines).

states.label: Sparse Checkpoint Seek
states.description: SparseLineIndex locates nearest checkpoint offset (indexed every 1,000 lines) for sub-millisecond seek.

states.label: Bounded Line & Byte Read
states.description: Reads lines up to target_end_line or until MAX_PREVIEW_BYTES (64 KB) limit is reached.

states.label: Secret Redaction Filter
states.description: Sanitizes tokens, credentials, and API keys line-by-line before rendering.

states.label: Deliver Telegram Preview
states.description: Renders bounded code block with line numbers, jump options, and size truncation notice if bounded.

states.label: Export Chunk Size Evaluation
states.description: Checks if file size <= MAX_DOWNLOAD_CHUNK_BYTES (10 MB) or requires multi-part chunking.

states.label: Direct Single Download
states.description: File is <= 10 MB; exports as single base64 attachment directly to Telegram.

states.label: Export Planner (build_export_plan)
states.description: Calculates deterministic chunks, splits text on newline boundaries, and preserves UTF-8 integrity.

states.label: Per-Part SHA-256 & Manifest Creation
states.description: Computes SHA-256 per part and whole-file SHA-256, generating ExportManifest with exact byte ranges.

states.label: Telegram Multipart Delivery
states.description: Presents export screen with parts list and manifest; delivers parts on-demand with verified integrity.
